scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p scripts
scripts.dev:all: npm run build && concurrently -n gateway,auth,files "npm run dev -w services/gateway" "npm run dev -w services/auth-service" "npm run dev -w services/file-upload-service"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n gateway,auth,files "npm start -w services/gateway" "npm start -w services/auth-service" "npm start -w services/file-upload-service"
scripts.migrate: npm run build && npm run migrate -w services/auth-service && npm run migrate -w services/file-upload-service
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && INTEGRATION=1 npm run test:integration -w services/auth-service && INTEGRATION=1 npm run test:integration -w services/file-upload-service
scripts.docker:up: npm run keys:generate && docker compose up --build
